title: USMC Dragon Slayer
author: John C.
desc: An 8-week beginner strength and conditioning program built for the USMC PFT and CFT. This plan combines progressive barbell training with structured running to improve overall strength, endurance, speed, and work capacity. Designed for new lifters, it emphasizes proper technique, consistent progression, and balanced recovery while building a foundation for long-term performance.

ex.note: Try to keep at 70-80% of your max weight for each set and it should feel like you have some gas left in the tank. For the last set complete an AMRAP (As Many Reps As Possible).
Should be a weight you can easily control. Focus on form over reps and STAY CONTROLLED! You can also stand on a rubber plate to increase ROM (Range Of Motion).
Lunge 10M on turf each set.
